rule: Endoscope station poses on the standard specimen (E5, Opus, 2026-10-07). Key "t.<id>.<side>" (a midline station: ".M", posed from the right nostril). pose: scope.js fields (fulcrum lm.naris.<side>). Every pose is free under scope.js shaftClearance with the 4 mm shaft and the E3b midline rule, its tip lies in airway air (not in mucosa: this specimen is not decongested, and a tip in tissue sees a uniform field), and its target is within the 35 degree half field. target: a landmark, or a label whose voxel centroid is the point, or an explicit RAS point "at" (between: the midpoint of two landmarks). measured: what a cone of rays (161, over the 70 degree field) hits first through the labelled air, in percent of the image; "tissue" is unlabelled soft tissue with no labelled wall within 8 mm behind it. The left poses are the right ones mirrored: the same side-relative depth, yaw and pitch, roll -> 360 - roll.
